overview: A hiring and onboarding roster for a store's roadie crew, with sign-ups, paperwork, orientation, training groups, crews, events and manager reporting.
features: Track roadies from sign-up through paperwork, orientation and certification
Approve new hires and manage roles and access
Build training groups and shift boards
Organize crews, crew events and RSVP answers
Opening Questions review with approvals and history
Read-only data access for an AI assistant, scoped to each person's real role
